code_examples.section: ltm rule event PING RESPONSE READY
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PING_RESPONSE_READY
       Triggered when TMM has received an HTTP response from PingAccess policy server

DESCRIPTION
       This event is triggered to execute HTTP commands after the response from ping access server is received.

Examples
	when PING_RESPONSE_READY {
	    HTTP::header insert header_1 value_1
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.0.0 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
